english: Production access panel for a nearby Storage Console. Queue one-time orders or maintain stock across up to 24 machines. Automatically supplies ingredients and wood and smelting materials. Collects finished goods. Includes mixers and forges and vanilla collectors. Starts paused. Solo worlds only.

Saves four equipment toolbelt and locked-backpack supply profiles. Holds no items: complete loadout swaps use the nearest accessible Storage Console and obey its chest cap range access and slot locks. Requires a console within 15 blocks by default.

Storage and production manager for the nearest 8 accessible player chests. Press E then PRODUCTION to queue recipes and manage machines within 15 blocks by default. Supplies real inputs and fuel and collects output. Upgrade with a Tier 2 kit. Close before upgrading. Solo worlds only.
Unified storage and production manager for up to 16 chests. Open PRODUCTION for orders and machines. Same range as Tier 1. Upgrade with a Tier 3 kit.
Unified storage and production manager for up to 32 chests. Open PRODUCTION for orders and machines. Same range as Tier 1. Upgrade with a Tier 4 kit.
Unified storage and production manager for up to 64 chests. Open PRODUCTION for orders and machines. Same range as Tier 1. Maximum tier.
Carry one kit and use the repair action of a stone axe or hammer or nailgun on a fully repaired Tier 1 console. Doubles its capacity to 16 chests. Consumed on upgrade.
Carry one kit and use a repair tool on a fully repaired Tier 2 console. Doubles its capacity to 32 chests. Consumed on upgrade.
Carry one kit and use a repair tool on a fully repaired Tier 3 console. Doubles its capacity to 64 chests. Consumed on upgrade.
